description: This file defines functions and classes related to universal functions (ufuncs) in PyTorch's code generation system, including type handling, argument processing, and kernel naming conventions.

classes.name: UfunctorBindings
classes.description: A data class holding lists of constructor and apply bindings for ufunctors.

methods.name: schema_kernel_name
methods.description: Generates a kernel name string for a given function schema and dispatch key.

methods.name: kernel_name
methods.description: Generates a kernel name for a group and dispatch key.

methods.name: dispatchstub_type
methods.description: Determines the dispatch stub type for a given type, used for CPU kernels.

methods.name: opmath_type
methods.description: Returns the operation math type corresponding to a scalar type.

methods.name: ufunctor_ctor_type
methods.description: Determines the constructor type for a ufunctor based on the input type.

methods.name: ufunctor_apply_type
methods.description: Determines the apply type for a ufunctor based on the input type.

methods.name: ufunc_type
methods.description: Determines the computation type for a ufunc based on the input type.

methods.name: ufunctor_ctor_argument
methods.description: Creates a constructor argument binding for a ufunctor.

methods.name: ufunctor_apply_argument
methods.description: Creates an apply argument binding for a ufunctor.

methods.name: ufunc_argument
methods.description: Creates a binding for a ufunc argument.

methods.name: ufunctor_arguments
methods.description: Generates constructor and apply bindings for ufunctors based on function arguments.

methods.name: ufunc_arguments
methods.description: Generates argument bindings for a ufunc's inner loop.

methods.name: stub_arguments
methods.description: Generates argument bindings for dispatch stubs, excluding tensor arguments.
